title: The $180 Stock That Grew to $7 Million

beats.say: In 1935, a quiet clerk named Grace Groner bought 3 shares of a healthcare company for $180.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a solitary clerk silhouette at a heavy mahogany desk in an empty, towering archive hall under cold fluorescent light.

beats.say: She put the paper certificate in a drawer, left it alone, and never added another single cent.
beats.visual: Extreme close up of weathered hands closing a dark wooden drawer with a brass pull, low angle, blue hour light.

beats.say: How did a tiny $180 purchase turn into a multi-million dollar fortune by the time she died?
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a massive concrete office tower edge cutting across a pale winter sky, sodium light bleeding from below.

beats.say: Most people assume you've got to trade daily, time the market swings, and dodge crashes to get rich.
beats.visual: High angle shot of a rain-slick street at night with streaks of red and white taillights rushing past in a blur.

beats.say: Grace didn't check tickers. She didn't panic when recessions hit. She just let the dividends reinvest quietly.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a person standing alone on a vast concrete overpass, looking out at dark open water under heavy fog.

beats.say: What happened to her tax bill while those shares compounded for 75 uninterrupted years?
beats.visual: Extreme close up of wet asphalt reflecting a single practical amber light in an empty alleyway at night.

beats.say: She never sold a share. That means she paid zero capital gains tax along the way. Friction stayed at absolute zero.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a massive steel suspension bridge tower disappearing into heavy fog and low clouds.

beats.say: How much was that original $180 stack actually worth when she passed away at age 100?
beats.visual: High angle shot looking down a steep, empty concrete stairwell lit by a single flickering fluorescent bulb.

beats.say: By the time she died, her little investment had quietly ballooned to over $7 million.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a tiny human silhouette walking across a vast, empty concrete dam at twilight.

beats.say: She left the entire sum to her college to fund scholarships, proving simple time beats clever timing every single time.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a hand resting on cold stone railing against a dark, moody ridge line at blue hour.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a solitary warm light shining from a single window in a towering concrete monolith at night.

caption:
Three shares. Zero trades. Seventy-five years of untouched compounding.
